headline: What Orbit does today.
subheadline: Only what ships. Each line below is in the product you can deploy now.

features.label: Pull requests
features.title: One check per PR, scoped to the diff
features.description: Changed files are traced through the System Map to the journeys they can reach. Orbit runs those, posts one GitHub check with what broke, and stays quiet when everything passes.

features.label: Replay
features.title: Passing steps replay without a model call
features.description: A case's first passing run is compiled into a replay script. Later runs replay it with zero model calls; when a step diverges the agent takes over from that step and saves the heal as the next version.

features.label: Previews
features.title: Railway and Cloudflare previews
features.description: Runs target the PR's preview deployment: Railway PR environments and Cloudflare Pages previews, including previews behind Cloudflare Access.

features.label: Failures
features.title: What broke, in plain English
features.description: Each failure comes with the cause, the step it failed at, screenshots around it and a suggested fix. Create a Linear issue from the failure in one click.

features.label: Self-host
features.title: Runs on your infrastructure
features.description: One web service, Postgres, Redis and a headless browser. Deploy on Railway or with docker compose; the first sign-in becomes the admin. A self-hosted instance has no usage limits.

features.label: Models
features.title: Bring your own model key
features.description: Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter, set per workspace. Every model call is attributed to the run that made it, so the cost of a run is visible.

features.label: MCP
features.title: MCP in both directions
features.description: Orbit exposes an MCP server so your coding agent can read the System Map, plans and results, and it can call your MCP tools during a test.

features.label: Integrations
features.title: GitHub, Linear, Slack
features.description: GitHub App for repo access, PR comments and checks. Linear for issues created from failures. Slack for run results and failure alerts in a channel you pick.
